name: Return of the Rabbit God
source:
Inspired by the Chinese deity Tu'er Shen.
The Rabbit God received prayers from three men in need of his guidance.

[From [url=https://filthysilver.itch.io/return-of-the-rabbit-god]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
灵感来自中国神兔儿神。
兔神收到了三个需要他指引的人的祈祷。

[来自[url=https://filthysilver.itch.io/return-of-the-rabbit-god]Itch.io[/url]]
